scope: Spline electron sector eS2o. 3D Bayesian phi_h in the copy of fits/spline/electron_sector/eS2o/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17. 420 fitted cells and 32 empty histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D were absent and were not created. No publication. The source file, sector_fit_exclusions_20261106.json, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows have median width 0.0158 and 463 of 489 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows are narrower (median 0.0073, 482 of 489 below 0.05), so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 420 histograms and the corrected first-to-last phi range. The manual limits and the halfway second pass left 11 histograms off the cosine those points support, and 26 more were still short of their own unconstrained cosine. Pass 2 put each of those starts on the better cosine, opened the limits so the start was not on the boundary, and refit Q2-y 1 2 3 5 6 7 8 9 10 11 13 14 15 16 17. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) stored B -0.045000 error 0.027225 chi-squared 16.260 NDF 7, retained B -0.119071 error 0.079405 C -0.008310 error 0.108723 chi-squared 15.969 NDF 7, phi 75-285, 14 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. Nominal B is -0.125184. The shift versus nominal is kept because it is this histogram's cosine. Excluded pairs were restored only when the manual pass was worse (0) and were not tuned to re-enter the budget. 29 histograms have a lower fair chi-squared than the stored fit, and none is worse than the better of the stored fit and the manual pass by more than 1. The stored TF1 range ran past the filled window in 24 histograms. After this refit, 0 range mismatches remain. JSON still has 420 bins. Q2-y 4 12 were not in pass 2 and match pass 1. Pass 3 refit only Q2-y 1 for (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8). Pass 2 had left B on the manual halfway boundary -0.075. The limit was opened to this histogram's unconstrained cosine, and Allow_Multiple_Fits_C was turned off so a near-zero C was not clipped to half its central value. The other Q2-y 1 cells stayed at least as good. The larger C error is the fit error, not a change in the systematic uncertainty.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. RC_Bayesian and BC_RC_Bayesian are absent and were not created. Excluded pairs stay omitted. Missing comparisons stay missing, not zero. Shapes that disagree with the nominal were kept.
